snapshot.whatIsHappening: Grenada-based destination-wedding planner offering planning, vendor coordination and day-of services. This is a recurring, timing-unconfirmed channel for wedding ceremony/reception catering, private e
snapshot.summaryWhat: Grenada-based destination-wedding planner offering planning, vendor coordination and day-of services. This is a recurring, timing-unconfirmed channel for wedding ceremony/reception catering, private e
snapshot.potentialHotelBusiness: Qualified relationship-development opportunity, not confirmed business on the books. BWG selects venues and coordinates catering and wedding suppliers, creating a plausible route to intimate luxury destination weddings at Spice Island Beach Resort. The resort explicitly advertises weddings for up to 35 guests, beach/garden settings, event staff and catering. Prioritize small ceremonies, private receptions and couple/honeymoon stays, with accompanying-guest accommodation subject to qualification. No existing BWG–resort partnership or referral agreement was verified; this is not a large-banquet or city-center transient lead.

establishedFacts: BWG is a wedding-planning business offering customizable services rather than one announced annual event.
Khadine Francis is the named founder/wedding specialist and a commercially relevant planner contact.
BWG publicly describes venue and vendor sourcing, contract review/oversight and vendor-payment services.
BWG publishes plan@beautifulweddingsgrenada.com and Phone/WhatsApp +1-473-406-7526.
Spice Island Beach Resort’s official wedding page states capacity up to 35 guests and advertises event staff, catering, wedding and honeymoon packages.
Elisabeth Housend is named on the resort’s official concierge page; she is an internal operational/referral contact, not a verified buyer for BWG.
uncertainties: No upcoming event date, current couple, banquet order, budget or committed room demand was found.
No verified room-block sourcing or hotel-contract signature authority was established for either named person.
No existing BWG relationship with Spice Island Beach Resort, preferred-supplier agreement or referral commission was verified.
BWG’s present pipeline and availability need direct confirmation; recent media coverage does not prove future bookings.
No second named BWG planner was verified; Elisabeth is a resort-side alternative, not a second external buyer.
Actual reception capacity/layout, external-planner policy, nonresident access, accessibility and incremental all-inclusive charges require resort confirmation.
qualificationQuestions: Are you actively accepting new weddings, and which upcoming couples have confirmed or flexible dates?
How many ceremony/reception guests are expected, and how many will travel to Grenada rather than attend locally?
Do you source accommodation and room blocks, or does the couple or a travel adviser handle this separately?
Who approves the hotel and budget, signs the event and accommodation agreements, and pays deposits and final balances?
What room categories, arrival/departure dates, stay lengths and booking arrangements are needed?
Is the event within the resort’s advertised 35-guest wedding scope, and what reception layout and weather backup are required?
Which catering, rehearsal dinner, private dining, spa and honeymoon elements are required beyond existing package inclusions?
Will the resort accept an external planner and preferred suppliers, and what access charges, insurance, vendor rules and commercial terms apply?
What mobility/accessibility, dietary, child-attendance, outside-guest and transport requirements must the resort confirm?
snapshot.recommendedNextStep: Send a personalized B2B introduction to Khadine at plan@beautifulweddingsgrenada.com, with one follow-up via the published BWG WhatsApp route if appropriate. Offer an exploratory site visit with the resort’s wedding team for intimate beach/garden weddings, explaining that availability, external-planner collaboration and commercial terms require confirmation. Ask whether she has an actual couple with dates and accommodation needs before quoting or holding inventory. Internally, ask Elisabeth to refer the enquiry to the wedding/group-sales decision-maker. Do not approach historical couples as current leads, imply an existing partnership, or promise referral fees or room blocks.

qualificationQuestions: Are you actively accepting new weddings, and which upcoming couples have confirmed or flexible dates?
How many ceremony/reception guests are expected, and how many will travel to Grenada rather than attend locally?

Who approves the hotel and budget, signs the event and accommodation agreements, and pays deposits and final balances?
What room categories, arrival/departure dates, stay lengths and booking arrangements are needed?
Is the event within the resort’s advertised 35-guest wedding scope, and what reception layout and weather backup are required?
Which catering, rehearsal dinner, private dining, spa and honeymoon elements are required beyond existing package inclusions?
Will the resort accept an external planner and preferred suppliers, and what access charges, insurance, vendor rules and commercial terms apply?
What mobility/accessibility, dietary, child-attendance, outside-guest and transport requirements must the resort confirm?
salesBrief.recommendedNextStep: Send a personalized B2B introduction to Khadine at plan@beautifulweddingsgrenada.com, with one follow-up via the published BWG WhatsApp route if appropriate. Offer an exploratory site visit with the resort’s wedding team for intimate beach/garden weddings, explaining that availability, external-planner collaboration and commercial terms require confirmation. Ask whether she has an actual couple with dates and accommodation needs before quoting or holding inventory. Internally, ask Elisabeth to refer the enquiry to the wedding/group-sales decision-maker. Do not approach historical couples as current leads, imply an existing partnership, or promise referral fees or room blocks.
